verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud agent-hosting platform with a CLI and SDKs, so offering a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or any opt-out control. Scoped keys and encrypted secrets are related security features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
